categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Xinyu Guoke Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: military products and civilian products. The military segment focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of pyrotechnic components and devices used in various branches of the armed forces. The civilian segment mainly involves artificial weather modification equipment, meteorological observation devices, and related software development, serving weather modification and environmental monitoring needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in pyrotechnic technology, including the production of pyrotechnic elements, devices, and systems with applications in military and meteorological fields. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques such as automated and intelligent production lines for pyrotechnic materials and devices. The company also integrates digital technologies like AI, big data, cloud computing, and IoT into its meteorological and weather modification equipment, focusing on innovation in smart, integrated, and automated systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include central and local military enterprises, armed forces branches (army, navy, air force, rocket forces, strategic support forces), public security and armed police units, and meteorological departments across over 20 provinces and nearly 1000 counties in China. The company also collaborates with domestic military trade companies for export markets. Civilian customers primarily consist of government meteorological agencies and environmental monitoring organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and production facilities in Jiangxi Province. Its products and services cover a broad domestic market including multiple provinces and municipalities. It also engages in international military trade through authorized military trade companies but does not have significant direct overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Xinyu Guoke Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures core pyrotechnic components and devices (midstream) and supplies finished products directly to military equipment assemblers and meteorological agencies (downstream). It maintains strict control over raw material sourcing and quality through qualified supplier lists and military representative inspections.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and R&D, investing nearly 9% of its main business revenue into research. It focuses on advancing pyrotechnic technology towards fourth and fifth-generation products, integrating digital and smart technologies into weather modification and meteorological equipment. Strategic R&D projects include automated production lines, integrated weather modification command vehicles, AI-based monitoring systems, and diversified special rockets. Collaboration with national research institutes and universities supports its innovation pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of military pyrotechnic products and civilian weather modification and meteorological equipment. The company uses a direct sales model without intermediaries, securing orders through military procurement events, bidding, and government contracts. It also earns revenue from software development and integrated system solutions in meteorological and environmental monitoring sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in military pyrotechnic products and artificial weather modification equipment, recognized for its comprehensive product range and technological capabilities. Major competitors include large state-owned military enterprises under China North Industries Group and China South Industries Group, as well as specialized rocket manufacturers like Zhongtian Rocket. The company faces competitive pressure from these well-funded central enterprises but maintains a strong position through product diversity and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 445 million, a 14.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 79 million, up 4.56%. Total assets reached over RMB 833 million, with steady growth in revenue and profitability. The company maintains a solid financial base with positive cash flow from operations, though cash flow declined by 19.5% compared to the prior year due to increased payments for goods and services.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a broad and integrated product portfolio covering military-grade pyrotechnic components and advanced artificial weather modification systems. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, a comprehensive product range with over 400 military and 100 civilian product types, and the ability to provide one-stop solutions encompassing equipment, software, and services. It emphasizes product safety, technological innovation, and compliance with stringent military and environmental standards, positioning itself as a key supplier in both defense and meteorological sectors.
